headline: Ecology beyond boundaries.
intro: Exploring how energy, nutrients, and contaminants move across aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems—and what these connections mean for food webs and biodiversity in a changing world.
welcome_text: I am an Assistant Professor in the Department of Biological Sciences at Louisiana State University. My research brings together field ecology, stable isotopes, fatty-acid biomarkers, and ecological modeling to study environmental change across freshwater, coastal, and terrestrial ecosystems.
